messages:
Mira Patel: Quick sync to finalize postmortem follow-ups — need firm owners/dates, decide status page wording, and agree RCA sharing policy + a recurrence-review trigger.

Omar Singh: I can take TTL enforcement. Estimate 5 business days for implementation + tests. Target: 2026-04-03.

Lena Ortiz: I'll own autoscaling thresholds & a canary probe. 3 business days. Target: 2026-03-31.

ops-bot: Created task: "Enforce TTL guard" -> Omar Singh -> due 1992758400. Created task: "Adaptive autoscale + canary" -> Lena Ortiz -> due 1992614400.

Mira Patel: For customer comms CS wants concise transparency. Proposal: publish a short status page entry within 24h and include a link to a redacted RCA summary. Full internal RCA remains internal; expanded sanitized RCA provided on request after Legal review/NDA if it contains sensitive logs.

CS Bot: CS requests a pre-approved email template for inbound customer asks. Template should include impact window, percent affected (if available), mitigation, ETA for fixes, and contact.

Omar Singh: Draft status blurb suggestion: 

"Incident: Elevated latency on hosted inference API
Status: Resolved
Summary: A deploy-time configuration change cleared cache TTLs during a traffic spike, increasing compute and latency for a small percentage of requests (~4%). Mitigation: Reverted the change and applied a temporary guard.
Next steps: Enforce TTL defaults, update autoscaling thresholds, add rollout gating. A redacted RCA summary is linked on the status page; full internal logs are not public."

Lena Ortiz: Looks fine. If metrics confirm ~4% we can include the number; otherwise use "small percentage". Also add a short FAQ link explaining what a "redacted RCA" contains.

Mira Patel: Recurrence policy proposal: if the same root cause tag appears more than twice in a 6-month window, trigger a 30-day recurrence review, produce a mitigation plan, and notify execs. Add this to the postmortem checklist.

Omar Singh: +1. Also propose a lightweight trends dashboard: incidents by root-cause tag with recurrence counts. Good for spotting patterns.

ops-bot: Checkpoint meeting scheduled: 2026-04-06 10:00 UTC to review fixes and recurrence dashboard.

Mira Patel: Action recap: 1) Omar: TTL guard by 2026-04-03, 2) Lena: autoscale + canary by 2026-03-31, 3) CS: prepare email template and review redacted RCA draft, 4) Add recurrence-review rule and trend dashboard to postmortem process, 5) Publish short status blurb once percent confirmed. I'll update the tracker and loop in Legal for sharing wording. :white_check_mark:
